items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Oh, what's the guy that T-Bone did all the battles with? ... INTERVIEWER: Roy Brown.

ctx.x: It pushed you a little bit in a direction you were not going.

It actually did. That is true. It pushed us because you would be surprised, the places we would play, we'd come in with a big band and they would say, man, we never thought you all had a band anything like this. We expected to see about four musicians and hear Brown singing the blues. They say, what, people were just turned around.
And -- but like you said, we are forced to play the blues, you know what I mean. We are forced to play the blues. Well, at that time, to tell you the truth, we hadn't been playing no blues.
